title: 3444. Minimum Increments for Target Multiples in an Array

examples.explanation: The minimum number of operations required to satisfy the condition is 1. Increment 3 to 4 with just one operation, making 4 a multiple of itself.
The minimum number of operations required to satisfy the condition is 2. Increment 8 to 10 with 2 operations, making 10 a multiple of both 5 and 10.
Target 7 already has a multiple in nums, so no additional operations are needed.
